avoid_bonk.name: Avoid HDMI Bonk / Blank Screen
avoid_bonk.description: Minimize or eliminate black screen delays during format changes between pre-roll and main content.

lldv_non_dv.name: Dolby Vision on Non-DV Display (LLDV)
lldv_non_dv.description: Enable Dolby Vision content on displays without native DV support via Low Latency Dolby Vision conversion.

best_audio.name: Best Audio Quality (Atmos/DTS:X)
best_audio.description: Optimize audio routing for highest quality lossless surround sound passthrough.

gaming_low_latency.name: Gaming / Low Latency
gaming_low_latency.description: Enable VRR, ALLM, and minimize processing for the lowest input lag gaming experience.

fix_preroll.name: Fix Pre-roll Visibility
fix_preroll.description: Fix issues where pre-roll video shows only 1 frame or black screen while audio plays.

hdr_passthrough.name: 4K HDR Passthrough
hdr_passthrough.description: Ensure clean 4K HDR10/HLG passthrough with correct color space and metadata.

minimize_format_switch.name: Minimize Format Switching
minimize_format_switch.description: Reduce the number of HDMI re-negotiations by standardizing output format across content types.
